# Zenra AI

> Zenra AI is an AI and software development company working with clients worldwide. It designs, builds and launches AI agents, custom AI tools, websites and web apps, online stores, and Windows, Mac and mobile apps. It also makes its own ready-made products: Zenra AI Agent, an AI chat agent for any website (Explore our Agents), and apps for creators: Zenra Video Downloader, Zenra AI Viral Clips and Zenra Video Splitter (Explore our Tools).

Key facts:
- Name: Zenra AI, website https://zenraai.com
- Type: AI and software development company, working with clients worldwide, in English.
- Services: AI agent development; custom AI tool development; custom web development (websites, web apps, landing pages); e-commerce store development (Shopify, WooCommerce and custom stores, plus monthly store management); app development (Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android apps).
- Delivery: most projects are delivered within a few days; bigger projects usually take about 5-6 days, sometimes a little more or less. The exact timeline is agreed with the client before work starts.
- Pricing: every project starts with a free estimate based on the client's idea and budget, then a fixed quote in US dollars, paid by milestone; monthly plans for ongoing work such as store management, agent care and support. Project form: https://zenraai.com/contact/
- Process: free 30-minute discovery call, written proposal with a fixed quote, design or prototype, build with live previews and progress updates, launch, then optional support.
- Ownership: clients own the code, designs, domains and accounts from day one. NDA on request.
- AI agents are built with approvals for important actions, human handoff, audit logs and least-privilege access.
- Ready-made agent: Zenra AI Agent answers customers 24/7 on any website (WordPress, Shopify, Wix and more) or on a shareable chat link and QR code, replies in the customer's language, saves leads, hands chats to the team, learns from the business's website and files, and runs on free Cloudflare hosting. Page: https://zenraai.com/agents/zenra-ai-agent/
- Own apps (Windows 10 and 11 today, Mac versions coming soon): Zenra Video Downloader: videos, playlists and channels from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and more in up to 4K or MP3, with a 1-day free trial, then $1 a month, $2 for 6 months, $3 a year or $10 lifetime; Zenra AI Viral Clips: turns long videos into ready-to-post 9:16 clips with captions, titles and speaker framing (launching soon, pre-orders open: $4 a month, $10 for 6 months, $15 a year or $35 lifetime, 30-day free trial at launch); Zenra Video Splitter: splits any video into equal clips in original quality, free.
- Replies to project inquiries within one business day.
- Contact: support@zenraai.com or https://zenraai.com/contact/

## Services
- [All services](https://zenraai.com/services/): AI agent development, custom AI tools, websites and web apps, e-commerce stores, and Windows, Mac and mobile apps - built by one team for clients worldwide.
- [AI agent development](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-agent-development/): Custom AI agents for customer support, sales and operations - connected to your apps, with approvals, logs and human handoff. Delivered in days, fixed quote.
- [Custom AI tool development](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-tool-development/): Custom AI tools and chatbots built on your own data: AI assistants, document extraction, knowledge search and AI features for your product. Fixed quote.
- [Custom web development](https://zenraai.com/services/custom-web-development/): Custom websites, web apps and landing pages - fast, secure, SEO-ready and easy to update. Built with modern frameworks, at a fixed price, in days.
- [E-commerce store development](https://zenraai.com/services/ecommerce-development/): Shopify, WooCommerce and custom e-commerce websites built to sell - payments, shipping, migrations, speed and monthly store management, delivered in days.
- [App development](https://zenraai.com/services/app-development/): Production-ready Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android apps - installers, auto-updates, licensing, payments and app store launch. Free estimate, fast delivery.

## Agents
- [Explore our Agents](https://zenraai.com/agents/): Ready-made AI agents from Zenra AI. Zenra AI Agent answers customers day and night on your website or a chat link, saves leads and hands chats to your team.
- [Zenra AI Agent](https://zenraai.com/agents/zenra-ai-agent/): An AI chat agent for your website: answers customers 24/7 in their language, saves leads and hands chats to your team. Trained on your own business.

## Tools
- [Explore our Tools](https://zenraai.com/tools/): Explore Zenra AI tools for Windows, with Mac coming soon: Video Downloader for 4K playlists and channels, AI Viral Clips for shorts and the free Video Splitter.
- [Zenra Video Downloader](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/): Video downloader for Windows PC: save YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X videos, playlists and whole channels in up to 4K or MP3. Free trial.
- [Zenra AI Viral Clips](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/): AI clip maker for Windows: turns long videos and podcasts into viral 9:16 Shorts, Reels and TikToks with captions, titles and speaker tracking. Free trial.
- [Zenra Video Splitter](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-splitter/): Free Windows app that splits any video into equal parts in seconds, in original quality, with cuts at natural pauses - for WhatsApp Status, Shorts and Reels.
